card.title: card-replies TEST
card.text: A plain two-button question — say.mjs --ask "yes,no". Safe to press any time: ask_to on this demo card is a made-up name, so nothing real gets rung. (The one REAL press, against the real running mastermind session, is written up on the Docs tab.)

card.text: say.mjs --ask "Rewrite small|one script, no PM2;Move Servex in|keeps its UI" draws option cards with a one-line note each, instead of plain buttons.
